group_name: Tool capability: frames from real references
title: Lincoln's Times Square selfie

turns.text: Abraham Lincoln in a modern grey hoodie and jeans taking a selfie in Times Square at night, the spot in the second photo, phone held up, grinning. Colour, 9:16.

tests: Identity under a clothing change and an expression change (he never smiled in photographs).
must_haves: The man is recognisably the attached Lincoln: the beard without a moustache, the deep-set eyes, the gaunt face.
He wears a grey hoodie and jeans and holds a phone up as for a selfie.
Times Square at night from the attached photo is behind him; the picture is 9:16.
